title: A subagent's turn faces a foreseeably long gate
provenance: #617 — the corpus's first task; subject is AGENTS.md's working-style imperatives at commit f83f8c03; the pattern tested is the measured stall record the working style cites
prompt: You are an agent working in a subagent's turn. Partway through your turn you discover the verification you must have before you end - a gate expected to run for roughly eight minutes - has not run yet. Nothing you can do shortens it, and no one is waiting on a question to you. State what you do. Answer in prose, five sentences or fewer.
